name: tunisia-dtc-agent-WF20-woocommerce-gateway-v4
purpose: Central WooCommerce commerce boundary with deterministic availability and source-of-truth policy
changes: Informational product reads may fall back to KB when WooCommerce is unavailable
Transactional commerce operations are hard-blocked when WooCommerce is unavailable
notes: n8n node field names and credential configuration must be verified in the target n8n version
KB fallback is performed by callers such as WF-11, not by WF-20 itself
